task: Create a multivariate flag named "dark_mode_copy" whose control value is "Checkout", with two variations "Pay securely" and "Complete order". Each variation must get 50% of users in every environment. Leave the flag enabled.
finalText: DONE: Created the multivariate flag `dark_mode_copy` (feature id 536) with control value "Checkout" and variations "Pay securely" and "Complete order" at 50% each. It is enabled, and I confirmed the same 50/50 allocation and enabled state in both Development (266) and Production (267).
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith feature create --help; flagsmith feature update --help 2>&1 | head -60; flagsmith config

flagsmith feature variant --help; flagsmith feature variant add --help 2>&1 | head -40; flagsmith feature variant set --help 2>&1 | head -60; flagsmith feature list --json | jq '.[] | .name' 2>/dev/null | head -50
flagsmith feature list 2>&1; flagsmith feature list --json 2>&1 | jq -r '.[].name' | grep -i dark; flagsmith environment --help 2>&1 | head -20

cd /tmp && flagsmith feature create dark_mode_copy --value "Checkout" --enabled --description "" --variants '[{"value":"Pay securely","weight":50},{"value":"Complete order","weight":50}]' 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; flagsmith feature get dark_mode_copy 2>&1; flagsmith feature variant list dark_mode_copy 2>&1
cd /tmp && for k in [env-307fa2817d0a46a5] [env-f3dcb296475d7895]; do echo "== $k"; flagsmith flag list -e $k 2>&1 | grep -i dark_mode; flagsmith api --help 2>&1 | head -5; break; done
cd /tmp && flagsmith api /api/v1/environments/[env-f3dcb296475d7895]/featurestates/ 2>&1 | head -5; flagsmith api --help | sed -n 1,30p

cd /tmp && flagsmith api /api/v1/environments/[env-307fa2817d0a46a5]/featurestates/ 2>&1 | jq -c '.results[] | select(.feature==536) | {environment, enabled, feature_state_value, multivariate_feature_state_values}'; flagsmith api /api/v1/environments/[env-f3dcb296475d7895]/featurestates/ | jq -c '.results[] | select(.feature==536) | {environment, enabled, feature_state_value, multivariate_feature_state_values}'
